title.hr: Antena iznad tla: zrcalna slika i kut zračenja
title.en: An antenna above ground: its image and the take-off angle

concept.hr: Tlo je zrcalo: izravni i odbijeni val zbrajaju se ili poništavaju po visini
concept.en: The ground is a mirror: direct and reflected waves add or cancel by height

summary.hr: Vodoravni i okomiti dipol i λ/4 groundplane na visini u λ, nad savršenim i lošim tlom: latice, kut zračenja, gubitak u tlu i gdje pada jedan skok.
summary.en: A horizontal or vertical dipole or a λ/4 ground plane at a height in λ over perfect or poor ground: the lobes, take-off angle, ground loss and one hop.
